title: Direction Cosine Matrix to Rotation Angles
text: Convert direction cosine matrix to rotation angles, 1 input, 1 output, {Action for invalid DCM} sets Block behavior; {Rotation Order} sets the block output rotation and {Tolerance for DCM validation} sets the tolerance eps. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rotation Order
params.values: Block output rotation order ZYX (default) | ZYZ | ZXY | ZXZ | YXZ | YXY | YZX | YZY | XYZ | XYX | XZY | XZX
